name: footpath
title: Footpath
description: A walking-diary theme built as a yellow waymark fingerpost on weathered-oak ground: the site's name on a white place plate atop a timber post, the menu as pointed enamel arms left and right by turns, and an archive where every stage is an arm with its date ranged right like a walking time.

tokens.--font-sign: the sign lettering, a bold humanist sans: the place plate, the arms, page titles, headings, dates, tags, the menu and the subscribe notice
tokens.--font-text: the old-style serif for reading: body text, standfirsts, the notes under archive arms, the footer
tokens.--text-s: small sign print: dates, tags, pagination, tables, the footer
tokens.--text-m: body text and the notes under archive arms
tokens.--text-l: standfirsts under titles, small headings, the subscribe notice's heading
tokens.--text-xl: the place plate, the archive's plate and headings inside a piece
tokens.--text-xxl: the big title at the top of each page
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of titles, plates and arms
tokens.--color-bg: the ground: weathered oak, and the lettering on the subscribe button
tokens.--color-text: black lettering: body text, titles, links and the subscribe button
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: standfirsts, the reading time, the footer, the edge of the e-mail field
tokens.--color-accent: the timber of the post, and the bars cut from it: the quotation bar, the rule, the subscribe notice's top edge
tokens.--color-grain: the dark grain lines drawn down the post
tokens.--color-sheen: the pale streaks of weathering between the grain lines on the post
tokens.--color-ground: the ground line the post is planted in and the tuft of grass at its foot
tokens.--color-arm: waymark yellow: the face of every arm, and the lettering and keyline of the current one
tokens.--color-arm-edge: the shadowed edge under each arm and each plate
tokens.--color-tip: the black enamel of the current arm in the menu, lettered in waymark yellow
tokens.--color-bolt: the bolt head on each arm where it meets the post
tokens.--color-plate: the white place plate and the archive's plate
tokens.--color-plate-ink: the lettering and the inner frame line on the plates
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules: the line under a piece's date, table rules, the footer rule
tokens.--color-panel: the lighter timber behind code and the subscribe notice
tokens.--measure: maximum width of the reading column
tokens.--arm-length: length of each arm in the menu, and of the back arm
tokens.--arm-point: how deep the point of an arm is cut
tokens.--space-1: hairbreadth gap: between tags, under a date line
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between a title and its standfirst, inside the subscribe notice
tokens.--space-3: page side padding, the gap between paragraphs and between archive entries
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections; the distance of the archive's post from the edge
tokens.--space-5: the air above the subscribe notice, the footer and the back arm
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the plates, code and the e-mail field
tokens.--rule: thickness of rules, hover underlines and field edges
